text: {"label":"Family-Centered and Parent-Mediated Behavioral Services","definition":"Work on involving parents and families in behavior-analytic assessment and treatment, including parent-mediated and family-centered service models, parent perspectives and emotional responses, parent well-being, and partnerships between practitioners and families.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centers on families' roles, perspectives, and well-being within services, rather than methods for training parents' skills, child assessment and treatment generally, or early-intervention care and rapport with young children."}
